title: Keepr: Go backup service implementation
description:
Build a Go backup service with YAML config, built-in scheduler, and web UI for monitoring.

**Architecture:** Single binary daemon using rsync for backups. In-memory state with SSE for live log streaming. Cron-based scheduler replaces external cron jobs.

**Tech Stack:** Go 1.25+, gopkg.in/yaml.v3, github.com/robfig/cron/v3, github.com/spf13/cobra, standard library for HTTP/exec/embed.

**Implementation phases:**
1. Tasks 1-5: Project setup and config loading
2. Tasks 6-7: State management with log buffer
3. Tasks 8-12: Backup runner (rsync, hooks, cleanup)
4. Task 13: Scheduler
5. Tasks 14-16: Web UI
6. Tasks 17-19: CLI commands
7. Tasks 20-22: Config example and testing

See docs/plans/2026-01-25-backup-manager-implementation.md for full details.

title: Replace dashboard meta refresh with AJAX polling
description:
# Replace Dashboard Meta Refresh with AJAX Polling

**Goal:** Eliminate full-page refreshes on the dashboard by replacing the meta refresh tag with JavaScript-based AJAX polling that updates the DOM selectively.

**Architecture:** Add a new JSON API endpoint `/api/dashboard` that returns server status data. The dashboard JavaScript will poll this endpoint every 5 seconds and update only the changed DOM elements, preserving user state (scroll position, theme preference during toggle, etc.).

**Tech Stack:** Go (backend API), Vanilla JavaScript (frontend polling/DOM updates)

---

## Files to modify:
- `web/server.go` - Add new `/api/dashboard` handler
- `web/templates/dashboard.html` - Remove meta refresh, add AJAX polling JS
- `web/server_test.go` - Add tests for new API endpoint

title: Create GitHub Actions CI workflow
description:
## Files
- Create: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

## Step 1: Create workflow file

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.25"

      - name: Build
        run: make build

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.25"

      - name: Test
        run: make test

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.25"

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
        with:
          version: latest
```

## Step 2: Verify workflow syntax is valid

Run: `cat .github/workflows/ci.yml | head -20`
Expected: YAML file exists with correct structure

## Step 3: Commit

```bash
git add .github/workflows/ci.yml
git commit -m "ci: add GitHub Actions workflow for build, test, lint"
```
